snippet.title: Revenant: Through The Veil – Official Cinematic Teaser
snippet.description:
Revenant: Through The Veil
Our journey begins.

This is the official teaser for Revenant: Through The Veil, an action RPG where you must fight through the Egyptian afterlife to try and resurrect your lost love. Developed by Excavator Studios, the game features story-driven exploration, intense souls-like combat, and mythological mystery.

🖌 2D Animation & Storyboarding:
Tahreem Cheema

🎙️ Voice Talent:
Tarek Dergham (@thadius75)

🌐 Follow Excavator Studios
Website: excavatorstudios.wixsite.com/revenant
Instagram: @excavatorstudios
X (Twitter): @excavatorgames
TikTok: @excavatorstudios
